series.name: Jungle Heart Tales
series.bible: A warm green valley with a river, a meadow and a dark pine forest. Animals speak, but they live like real animals: herds, packs, dens, storms, droughts, hunters. Milo is a small, clever, brave young fox who is often underestimated. Ragnar is the old white wolf who watches from a boulder and gives short wise rules. Drakon is the proud black wolf rival who bullies others but is not purely evil. Lakshmi is the kind, strong cow who protects the young. Bholu is the funny, clumsy donkey. Keep the same personalities in every episode.

genres: a rescue adventure with a ticking clock
a mystery in the forest with a twist
a friendship story where an enemy becomes a friend
a survival race against the weather
a funny misunderstanding that turns heroic

themes: A baby calf is lost near the dark pine forest and the whole valley must find her before night falls
The river is drying up and Milo must find the hidden spring before the herd leaves
A rumour of a monster in the forest turns out to be a lonely, frightened animal
Drakon's pack is trapped by a storm and Milo has to decide whether to help the rival who bullied him
Bholu accidentally wakes the whole valley at night and saves everyone from a falling tree
A young fox learns that the shortcut is not worth it when a flood comes
